AccountType.description: Finance account type. Known values: cash, bank, wechat, alipay, investment, other. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

ActivityCheckinMethod.description: Habit check-in method. Known values: manual, automatic. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

ActivityLogStatus.description: Habit log status. Known values: completed, partial, skipped. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

ActivityScheduleType.description: Habit schedule type. Known values: daily, weekly, custom. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

ActivitySyncSource.description: Habit sync source. Known values: fitness, english. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

ActivityType.description: Habit activity type. Known values: duration, count, completion, weekly, control. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

ApiErrorV1.description: Uniform API error body returned by sync endpoints.

AppId.description: Client application id. Known values: lifetrace-desktop, lifetrace-web, lifetrace-*-android.

AtomicGroupId.description: Groups changes that must be applied all-or-nothing in one push request.

ChangeId.description: Idempotency key for a sync change: userId + changeId must be unique per payload.

ChangeOperation.description: Change operation. Known values: upsert, delete. Unknown values are preserved.

ClientPlatform.description: Client platform. Known values: windows, android, web. Unknown values are preserved.

ConflictId.description: Stable id assigned by the server to a returned conflict.

oneOf.description:
Client `baseServerVersion` must equal the current server version;
otherwise an explicit conflict is returned. No automatic last-write-wins.
The server is authoritative; client writes are rejected or ignored.
No conflict semantics (device-local / not synced data).

ConflictReason.description: Conflict reason. Known values: base_version_mismatch, client_modified_server_deleted, client_deleted_server_modified, both_deleted. Unknown values are preserved.

ConflictV1.description:
Explicit conflict returned by the server. Resolution is client-side:
`keep_server`, `keep_local` (new changeId, based on the latest server
version) or `manual_merge`. No automatic last-write-wins.

serverEntity.description: Current server entity (or tombstone payload) for client resolution.

Cursor.description:
Opaque server cursor. Clients must never parse, add, subtract or guess it.
Wire format: string.

DeviceId.description: Stable device identifier (string, usually UUID v4).

EnglishCategory.description: English article category. Known values: Technology, Science, Life, Business, Culture. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

EnglishCompletionStatus.description: English learning record completion status. Known values: reading, summarized, analyzed, completed. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

EnglishFetchStatus.description: English article fetch status. Known values: PENDING, SUCCESS, FAILED, SKIPPED. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

EnglishLevel.description: CEFR level. Known values: A1, A2, B1, B2, C1. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

EnglishProcessingStatus.description: English article processing status. Known values: FETCHED, CLEANED, ANALYZED, READY, REJECTED, FAILED. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

EnglishReadingStatus.description: English reading status. Known values: unread, reading, completed. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

EntityId.description: Entity identifier. New IDs are UUID v4; legacy non-UUID IDs are preserved verbatim.

EntityMeta.description:
Metadata shared by every syncable entity payload.

`local_version` is the local revision counter (EPIC-01 `version` column).
It is NOT a server authority; `server_version` is assigned by the server
and `base_server_version` (on changes) is what the client knew when it
made the change. Offline edits must never fabricate `server_version`.

localVersion.description: Local revision number (never the server-authoritative version).

modifiedByDevice.description: Device that last modified the entity locally (audit only).

serverVersion.description: Server-authoritative version; `None` until the server first accepts it.

oneOf.description: Owned and edited by the user; bidirectional sync with conflict checks.
Managed by the server (for example identity.user, identity.device).
Global catalog shared by all users (for example english.article).
Only meaningful on the device that created it; never synced.
Credentials and secrets; MUST NEVER enter a sync payload.

EntityRef.description: A typed reference to another syncable entity.

EntitySnapshotV1.description: One current entity in a snapshot.

EntityType.description: Registered entity type. Known values: identity.user, identity.device, finance.account, finance.category, finance.transaction, finance.transaction_evidence, habit.activity, habit.log, review.daily, note.folder, note.note, note.tag, note.tag_relation, note.relation, note.revision, english.article, english.learning_record, english.highlight, english.note, english.vocabulary, english.vocabulary_occurrence, english.vocabulary_review_state, workout.import, workout.workout, workout.exercise, workout.set, workout.training_note, file.metadata, entity.link, user.preference. Unknown values are preserved.

ErrorCode.description: Stable error code. Unknown codes from newer servers are preserved verbatim.

code.description: Field-level error code (string; server-defined, forward compatible).

FileMetadata.description:
`file.metadata`

Never contains object storage keys, presigned URLs or local absolute
paths; only stable metadata and a content hash.

FileStorageState.description: File storage state. Known values: local_only, pending_upload, server_stored. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

HighlightColor.description: English highlight color. Known values: yellow, green, blue. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

ImportStatus.description: Workout import status. Known values: pending, success, failed. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

LocalDate.description: A natural calendar day in `YYYY-MM-DD` (wire format).

MinimumClientVersion.description: Minimum required client version for one app id.

MoneyAmount.description: A monetary amount: integer cents plus currency.

amountCents.description: Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents). Never use floats.

Note.description:
`note.note`

The sync payload is the authoritative full snapshot (including content).
Tags, relations, attachments and revisions are separate entity types.

revisionVersion.description: Revision counter within the note (distinct from `meta.localVersion`).

NoteTagRelation.description:
`note.tag_relation`

The entity id is the stable composite `<noteId>:<tagId>`.

NoteType.description: Note type. Known values: quick, document, daily, habit_log, workout_review, expense_note, weekly_review, monthly_review. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

afterCursor.description:
Opaque server cursor. `None` means "start from the beginning" (may be
answered with `LIFETRACE_SNAPSHOT_REQUIRED` when history is pruned).

PullResponseV1.description:
`POST /api/v1/sync/pull` response.

Changes are ordered strictly by server cursor. Clients MUST apply them in
order and MUST NOT re-sort by `updatedAt`; only persist `next_cursor` after
the whole batch succeeded.

PushChangeResultV1.description:
Per-change push result. `status` is one of `accepted`, `duplicate`,
`conflict`, `rejected`. Business conflicts are returned per change and do
not fail the whole HTTP request.

oneOf.description:
Same changeId with identical payload was already applied; first result
is returned and nothing is written twice.

`baseServerVersion` did not match the current server version, or the
entity state changed in a conflicting way. Contains the current server
entity/tombstone for client resolution.
The change was rejected with a stable error code.

requestId.description: Tracing only; never replaces `changeId` for idempotency.

RequestId.description: Request tracing id. It never replaces changeId for idempotency.

ServerChangeV1.description: A change as served by pull, in strict server cursor order.

tombstone.description: Present for `delete` (and for conflicts involving deletion).

ServerVersion.description:
Server-authoritative entity version. Wire format: decimal string
(for example `"42"`) to avoid JavaScript safe-integer issues.

SnapshotId.description: Stable id assigned by the server to a snapshot; all pages share one consistent view.

snapshotId.description:
Omitted on the first page; the server assigns one and expects it on
subsequent pages so all pages share one consistent view.

SnapshotResponseV1.description:
`POST /api/v1/sync/snapshot` response.

All pages of one snapshot correspond to one consistent view. After the
client finishes (completed == true), it sets its cursor to
`snapshot_cursor` and continues with Pull from there; concurrent changes
are then received without gaps.

SyncChangeV1.description:
One client change. `upsert` payloads are complete entity snapshots (no
JSON patch). `delete` carries no payload by default; the server creates a
tombstone. `client_modified_at` is audit-only and never used for ordering
or conflict resolution.

atomicGroupId.description:
Changes sharing an atomic group must be in one request and succeed or
fail together.

baseServerVersion.description:
Server version the client knew when making this change (`"0"` for new
entities). Never fabricated offline.

clientModifiedAt.description: Audit only. Never used for global ordering or conflict resolution.

dependencies.description: Entities this change depends on (must exist before applying).

payload.description: Full entity snapshot for `upsert`; empty for `delete`.

SyncClientInfo.description:
Sync client info carried by every request body (headers may also carry it;
the server validates consistency).

TombstoneV1.description:
Server-generated record of a deleted entity.

Re-creating a deleted entity requires a NEW entity id. Restoring a soft
delete must explicitly submit based on the tombstone's latest
`server_version`.

amountCents.description: Amount in cents. Never floats on the wire.

localDate.description: Business natural day `YYYY-MM-DD`; never derived from UTC slicing.

TransactionStatus.description: Financial transaction status. Known values: candidate, provisional, confirmed, ignored. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

TransactionType.description: Financial transaction type. Known values: expense, income, transfer, refund, fee. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

UserId.description: Stable user identifier (string, usually UUID v4).

UserPreference.description:
`user.preference`

Only syncable preferences belong here. Secrets (API keys, refresh tokens,
passwords) are `secret_local_only` and MUST NOT be sent in a sync payload.

VocabularyReviewResult.description: Vocabulary review result. Known values: FORGOT, HARD, GOOD, EASY. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

VocabularyStatus.description: Vocabulary status. Known values: LEARNING, REVIEWING, MASTERED, ARCHIVED. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

Workout.description: `workout.workout` (summary; exercises and sets are separate entities).

WorkoutSource.description: Workout source. Known values: manual, xunji. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).

WorkoutStatus.description: Workout status. Known values: completed, partial. Unknown values are preserved (forward compatible).
